body: I live in Amsterdam and I am open to research roles, internships and collaborations in robotics, embodied AI and creative machine learning.

pages.title: What is next
body: I am looking for research roles and internships in robotics, embodied AI and creative machine learning, ideally where a thesis and a job can be combined.
If you work on control, generative systems or anything that runs in real time, I would like to hear from you.
